title: Higher direct image open restriction
statement: For any morphism of schemes $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme], any open $U\subset S$, any module $M$ on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and any $p\in\mathbb N$, there is an isomorphism of module sheaves on $U$: $R^p(f|_U)_*(M|_{f^{-1}U})\cong (R^p f_*M)|_U$. Here ordinary higher direct images are [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. There are no quasi-coherence, affine or finiteness hypotheses.

proof.text: Use the existing Scheme.Modules.nonempty_higherDirectImage_iso_restrict on the open-base-change cartesian square isPullback_morphismRestrict, flipped to match its arguments. Enough injectives on X and the inverse-image open are supplied by moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives. The source theorem computes the source module by pullback along the source inclusion. Mathlib restrictFunctorIsoPullback identifies restriction with this pullback; apply the degree-p right-derived restricted direct-image functor to its component and compose with the source isomorphism. The existing theorem proves the restriction comparison by termwise restriction of an injective resolution and exact restriction of homology, as in 01E1 and 01E5. No affine or finiteness hypotheses are used.

theorem nonempty_higherDirectImage_openRestriction_iso
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (U : S.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ∣_ U).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M)) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M))
